summary: Implemented a bounded GitHub Actions read-only public-origin attestation runner for the generic text-to-audio candidate. The successful run fetched the public candidate and backend health endpoint with GET only, recorded response hashes, verified candidate/backend/MAX=1800 markers and health maxChars=1800, and enforced a pre-network guard that blocks POST.
